sammendrag: Stackable credential programs—that is, programs that facilitate students' ability to earn multiple certificates or degrees—have been a priority for Ohio. In this report, RAND researchers examine students who earned postsecondary certificates in Ohio and went on to earn additional educational credentials. Focusing on three fields, the researchers describe which types of credentials were earned and how students progressed through institutions.
tittel: Stacking Educational Credentials in Ohio: Pathways Through Postsecondary Education in Health Care, Manufacturing and Engineering Technology, and Information Technology
